cohort: 250 live-birth newborns delivered either by Spontaneous Vaginal Delivery (SVD) or Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) at the Institute of Medical Sciences, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India
finding: All 250 newborns screened negative for congenital hypothyroidism (CH) based on TSH levels measured from dried blood spots.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in TSH levels based on type of delivery (SVD/LSCS).
birth_weight: N/A, although study did categorize into Normal Birth Weight (NBW) and Low Birth Weight (LBW)
